Role Summary: Carries out planned and reactive maintenance on the clean water distribution network, including repairing burst mains and operating valves.
Develops long-term investment plans for water assets, modelling deterioration and prioritising capital schemes.
Handles inbound customer contacts about billing, supply interruptions and water quality concerns.

Optimises treatment processes at wastewater works, analysing performance data and advising on chemical dosing.
